inlines.v: UNLA'BORED, adjective 1. Not produced by labor; as unlabored harvests. 2. Not cultivated by labor; not tilled. 3. Spontaneous; voluntary; that offers without effort; natural. And from the theme unlabor'd beauties rise. 4. Easy; natural; not stiff; as an unlabored style.
